in_sanskrit.name: वामिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Daughter of the left hand or side, or the one who moves to the left

in_marathi.name: Vamika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vamika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vamika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vamana’, which refers to the dwarf incarnation of Lord Vishnu. This name is believed to bring good fortune and blessings of prosperity and strength. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vamana is known to have assumed a dwarf form and granted a boon to King Mahabali, who had defeated Indra, the king of gods, in a battle.
